job.value: find and go back to a liked listing

arrivedFrom.value: the Likes shortcut on Explore or the Me tab

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Likes' title over a grid of listings each with a red heart says what this is.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The listing cards themselves are the tap targets and dominate the screen.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Cards and hearts are clear, but 'Compare' at top right doesn't say what it compares or how items are picked.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'SOLD', 'Certified', 'Buyer Protection' and condition labels are ones a returning buyer knows.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: No decision is asked beyond picking a listing.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Card menus sit behind the '⋮' on each photo.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is a liked listing with price, condition and seller.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Photos, prices and short labels carry it with no prose.
